notes.title: Notify "The Memory" official release!
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33678060/feaa2919f7e82e8dc95a544739ea4947e1f9b3eb.png[/img]

Finally, [b]The Memory[/b] is about to be officially launched.
Many things have happened so far, so the official launch was later than expected.

we make up for the game fun and the lack of a story
We actively reflected players feedback,
and tried hard to express that in the game.

[b]Added to according to feedbacks[/b]

[i]-A different progression from Early Access.

-Save&Load function

-Achievement

-Add Tutorial

-More risk factors

-Adjust difficulty balance

-a lot of small bugs fixed[/i]


Experience the rest in the game!
currently, We are working at the last stage.
It will be released as soon as the update is made available.

[h1]Thank you for your support.[/h1]

notes.title: First Patches fixed by users feedback
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33678060/9c442b7ed02b23062a06f0f1b94e195c0098266f.png[/img]
- Changed to make it easier to play by eliminating the effect that the menu window looks horribly
  that proportional to the Health point.

-'Readable documents' was easy to pass.
 →Add glitter effect

- Modified to a location that makes items easier to get.

- Added HP(Health Point) UI

- Fov value change 90d to 104d
 for a little better view.

- position of the aim when opening and closing the door
 door handle → whole door body

- Our team has finally figured out that damn black screen that has upset everyone. and it's fixed!

- Other bug fixes
*'If you try to open the door for the first time, the door opens and closes immediately.'
*Fixed wrong textures.
*Fixed a problem that was not applied when setting options on the title screen.

The feedback you give us is a great help to us!
Thank you very much for those who gave us reviews!
Feedback is collected every week and will be reflected in game updates!
Thank you very much!
